dreamteamer.title: Perspective
dreamteamer.description: Read a contributor's existing work and end with their PERSPECTIVE existing — the operating model their work actually runs on, and a proposal for how to adapt this workspace to track and automate it. One resumable `retrospective-sessions` record walks thirteen stages: `installed`, then `inventoried` (what evidence is reachable — `sources`, `repos`, and the session RECORDS what it saw), `read` (condense every source — `conversations`, `activity-weeks`, `tickets`, `threads`, `world/deliverables`, and the people behind them as `world/users`; the workspace is a source too, giving `terms`, `concepts` and `world/decisions` from its own vocabulary), `clustered` (what was done — `world/activities`, `topics`, and the commitments behind them as `world/tasks`, derived mechanically from the tickets), `projected` (`world/projects`, the `world/phases` each one passed through and the `world/activity-lanes` the activities inside it run in), `extracted` (what was decided and said — `workflows`, more `world/decisions`, and the vocabulary in two steps: `terms` IDENTIFIED verbatim from the evidence with their spellings and counts, then CLASSIFIED into the `concepts` whose meaning they share — many terms, one concept, and a term left unclassified is an honest residue rather than a gap to paper over), `inferred` (what the work was FOR — `goals`, read backwards out of decisions and activity arcs, never out of what the person said), `found` (what recurs — `findings`, `insights`, and the `assumptions` each one rests on, every assumption carrying the observation that would prove it wrong), `interviewed` (what the evidence cannot settle — `questions`, written before they are asked), `proposed` (what the brain should keep — `proposals`, whose body IS the draft descriptor), `synthesised` (`perspectives`), then `materialised` and `seeded`. ⚠ EVIDENCE AND MODEL RECORDS ARE KEYED BY THE CONTRIBUTOR, not by the run, so a second retrospective UPDATES the operating model rather than writing a parallel copy beside it. ⚠ NOTHING HERE IS AUTHORED TRUTH — every record is what a run FOUND, and `confirmed` is reserved for what a person actually answered. ⚠ THE `perspective/world` NAMESPACE IS THE OBSERVED WORLD, expressed with the real world's own nouns — `world/users`, `world/projects`, `world/phases`, `world/activity-lanes`, `world/activities`, `world/tasks`, `world/goals`, `world/decisions` and `world/deliverables` mirror, one for one, the nine shapes `users` and `projects` ship — the whole projects model, with nothing observed left outside it. Every structural reference RE-POINTS inside the layer — an observed activity's `project` and `lane` name `perspective/world/projects` and `perspective/world/activity-lanes`, never the real collections. They are PARALLEL objects, never `extends:` overlays: a merged collection could not tell a record a run FOUND from one a person WROTE, and the two cannot even share an id shape. Each carries `real` — a ONE-WAY, SOFT reference to the authored record it appears to be, so the correspondence is a proposal a person confirms and the real world never gains a field pointing at a finding. `concepts.classifies` points a MEANING at those world objects and `concepts.related_to` at the real ones; `terms.mentions` points a WORD at the records it is load-bearing in, which is the narrower question. Every MODEL-tier record also carries the `perspective-observation` quad — `observed` (a date-time, so the whole tier sorts on one axis), `context`, `wrong_if` and a one-way soft `related` — because a model record is a claim about somebody's world at a moment, and the moment, the circumstance, the falsifier and the blast radius are four facts `creation_context` was being asked to carry in one line. The EVIDENCE tier deliberately does not carry it: those rows are counted, never judged. Holds evidence, findings and proposals only, never a domain object; `bin/check-records.mjs` is the guard a consuming workspace chains after `dreamteamer check`.
